Taxes kept as one unlabeled line (no printed Debt Service breakdown; the Statement of Activities 'Property taxes - levied for debt service' 180,908 does not equal 194,836); Intergovernmental kept as one line (p14 prints only all-funds homestead/property tax credit totals).
